brief: Board remains risk-off: BTC, ETH, SOL, LINK and AAVE sit in 1d breakdowns with HYPE the lone strength. New: LINK short (range_breakout, 1d breakdown, volRatio 5.85, OI 24h +3.24 on new_shorts), low conviction. Open: AAVE watching, kPEPE, UNI and XMR long triggered. kPEPE funding has dropped to 10.95 from the 74.55 premise but premium is 11.71 bps and CEX is -141.62, so the HL-local read persists; we re-check it next run (L2). hl-cycles is stale at 9.4 h. A reclaim of the broken 1d lows would prove the breakdown read wrong.
